others.title: Muru
others.excerpt: Muru Graham Dumpleton started mod_wsgi 20 years ago, and has been thinking about the ideal way to serve Python web applications in production ever since. As he did with wrapture , he's been publishing an extraordinarily detailed account of the project as he works on it - as part of his development process.
